Weeknight Lentil Soup

A thick, warming soup made from pantry staples in under forty minutes. It keeps for four days and freezes well, so make a double batch on Sunday and eat it all week.

Prep Time: 10 mins
Cook Time: 30 mins
Servings: 6

Ingredients

  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 onion, chopped
  • 2 carrots, diced
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 1/2 cups dry brown lentils, rinsed
  • 1 can (14 ounces) crushed tomatoes
  • 6 cups vegetable broth
  • 1 teaspoon ground cumin
  • Salt and pepper to taste

Directions

  1. Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and carrots until soft, about 8 minutes.
  2. Stir in the garlic and cumin and cook for one minute, until fragrant.
  3. Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 25 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
  4. Season with salt and pepper. Blend a third of the soup and stir it back in for a thicker texture.
